title: BrushOff: Stroke-Based Re-rendering as a Watermark Removal Attack on Painting
title_zh: BrushOff：基于笔触的重绘作为针对绘画的水印去除攻击

paragraphs.en: 研究提出无需训练、不依赖水印知识的BrushOff笔触重绘攻击，可高效移除图像水印，揭示了现有水印的脆弱性。 Invisible watermarks are used to mark who owns a painting. We show that a simple attack removes the most robust one we test. The attack redraws the watermarked painting with brush strokes, using a pretrained stroke-based renderer. We call this attack BrushOff. It needs no training, no knowledge of the watermark, and no generative model. We test four watermarks on 500 paintings from five styles. VINE, a recent watermark built to survive image editing, survives all 14 conventional distortions we test, with at least 97.8% detection. Repainting lowers its detection to 1.8%, while the output keeps a no-reference quality score close to that of the clean paintings. Diffusion regeneration can also remove VINE, but at the same removal level it moves the image twice as far from the painting in DreamSim distance, and it changes what the painting shows. Because the renderer draws a countable number of strokes, we can control the attack strength step by step. Finally, we test what kind of signal survives. A simple probe that stores bits in the relative brightness of neighboring regions survives repainting, while a probe that uses absolute brightness does not. The same probe fails under diffusion regeneration, while VINE fails under repainting. Robustness to these two attacks is therefore a separate property, and benchmarks should test both.
paragraphs.zh: 研究提出无需训练、不依赖水印知识的BrushOff笔触重绘攻击，可高效移除图像水印，揭示了现有水印的脆弱性。隐形水印被用来标记一幅画的拥有者。 我们证明，一种简单的攻击就能移除我们所测试的最鲁棒的水印。 该攻击使用预训练的基于笔触的渲染器，以笔触重绘带水印的画作。 我们将这种攻击称为BrushOff。 它无需训练、无需了解水印，也无需生成模型。 我们在500幅来自五种风格的画作上测试了四种水印。 VINE是一种为在图像编辑中存留而构建的新型水印，它在我们测试的全部14种常规失真下均能存留，检测率至少为97.8%。 重绘将其检测率降至1.8%，同时输出保持与干净画作接近的无参考质量分数。 扩散再生成也可以移除VINE，但在相同移除水平下，它使图像在DreamSim距离上偏离原画两倍之远，并且改变了画作所呈现的内容。 由于渲染器绘制的是可数的笔触数量，我们可以逐步控制攻击强度。 最后，我们测试了什么样的信号能够存留下来。 一种将比特存储在相邻区域相对亮度中的简单探针能够在重绘后存留，而使用绝对亮度的探针则不能。 同样的探针在扩散再生成下失效，而VINE在重绘下失效。 因此，对这两种攻击的鲁棒性是彼此独立的属性，基准测试应当同时检验二者。
